name: harnessloop
description: Evidence-backed long-task takeover and execution for AI agents.

interface.longDescription: Harnessloop helps AI agents take over and continue long-running project tasks with transfer packets, file-based evidence, scope locks, validation gates, handoffs, and self-audit before continuation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $harnessloop-init for harnessloop:init, $harnessloop-goal for harnessloop:goal, $harnessloop-evidence for harnessloop:evidence, $harnessloop-channels for harnessloop:channels, $harnessloop-connectivity for harnessloop:connectivity, or $harnessloop-loop for full loops.
